_meta.title: Session 23 — 7 user-provided refs: Fara1.5 + Asa-W1 + Open Agent Leaderboard + 3 arxiv refs
_meta.context: User provided 7 reference links for investigation. Findings: (1) arxiv 2604.05550v1 AutoSOTA — automated research system paper, no models/benchmarks to ingest, system contribution only. SKIP. (2) Microsoft Fara1.5 (microsoft.com/research/articles/fara1-5-computer-use-agent) — NEW model family (4B/9B/27B) for browser computer-use, released May 21 2026, based on Qwen3.5. Full benchmark panel on Online-Mind2Web + WebVoyager + WebTailBench v1.5 (Outcome+Process) + ScreenSpot-Pro + OSWorld-G Refined. (3) agent.openmed.life — OpenMed Agent CLI product page, model-agnostic, no benchmarks. SKIP. (4) NexgeneAI Asa-W1 — NEW medical reasoning model with rich HealthBench Professional 2026 results: overall 80.2, 28 specialties tracked, 3 use cases (consult/writing/research), 3 difficulty slices, head-to-head vs CGPT-C and physician baseline. PDF archived (740KB). (5) Asa-W1 blog — 403 Cloudflare-gated, but PDF supplies all data. (6) Open Agent Leaderboard (HF Space) — agent-framework × backbone-model matrix (5×5=25 entries), 6 benchmarks (App / Browse / SWE / Tau-Air / Tau-Ret / Tau-Tel) + Avg Success + Cost. (7) arxiv 2602.22953 'General Agent Evaluation' (Bandel et al, IBM Research, Feb 26 2026 / revised May 11) — systematic comparison of tool-call vs MCP vs code-gen vs CLI agent architectures across 6 benchmarks × 5 LLMs. Architecture variance up to 12pp within a single model. Methodology contribution, no per-bench-per-model scores in abstract. SKIP for scores but cite as Resources reference.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Fara1.5 panel scores verbatim from Microsoft Research article. Asa-W1 scores verbatim from PDF Table 1 + Table 2 + Table 4 + Figure 2. Open Agent Leaderboard scores verbatim from HF Space live snapshot. 11 new models registered (3 Fara1.5 sizes + Fara-7B predecessor + Asa-W1 + GUI-Owl 8B/32B + Yutori Navigator n1 + Holo2 30B + OpenAI Operator + Google Gemini 2.5 CU). 8 new benchmark IDs: webtailbench_v15_outcome / webtailbench_v15_process / screenspot_pro_delta / osworld_g_refined_delta (Fara1.5 publishes deltas only) + 6 Open Agent benchmarks (app/browse/swe/tau-air/tau-ret/tau-tel). healthbench_professional already exists; Asa-W1 + comparison scores added. Online-Mind2Web + WebVoyager already exist; Fara1.5 scores added.

scores._section: === Microsoft Fara 1.5 family — Computer-Use Agent benchmarks (May 21 2026) ===
=== NexgeneAI Asa-W1 — HealthBench Professional 2026 full panel ===
scores._note: Overall rubric-weighted (n=524). SE 1.57. +21.2 over CGPT-C; +36.5 over physician baseline. Largest reported gap vs physician baseline on this benchmark to date.
Care consult slice. SE 2.35. vs CGPT-C 51.0 / GPT-5.4 50.8 / GPT-5.4+browse 50.0 / Physician 42.7.
Writing & documentation. SE 3.53. vs CGPT-C 64.1 / GPT-5.4 34.6 / GPT-5.4+browse 19.7 / Physician 32.1.
Medical research. SE 2.13. vs CGPT-C 67.0 / GPT-5.4 58.1 / GPT-5.4+browse 66.5 / Physician 56.3.
Red-teaming difficult slice (n=190). SE 3.33. vs CGPT-C 55.8 / GPT-5.4 26.2 / Physician 30.0. +11.6 over CGPT-C; +41.2 over GPT-5.4 base.

scores._note: OpenAI Solo sdk 0.7.0 agent — top entry at 72.7% Avg Success, $5.97. Best on App 68 / Browse 61 / SWE 80.7 / Tau-Air 74 / Tau-Ret 85 / Tau-Tel 84.
OpenAI Solo + Opus 4.5 — top SWE score in panel.
React + Shortlist agent with Gemini Pro 3 — best price/performance entry in top 5 at $0.51 cost vs $5.97 (~12x cheaper).
React + Shortlist + GPT-5.2 — cheapest sub-50% entry at $0.21.
OpenAI Solo + DeepSeek V3.2 — surprisingly strong SWE at very low cost ($0.09).
